features: PERFORMANCE UNLEASHED - Galaxy M47 5G delivers Next Level Monster performance with its strong combination of Powerful Snapdragon Processor, Fast LPDDR5x and Fast UFS 3.1. It is made in India and it enables smooth multitasking and peak gaming performance with faster app switching reduced stutter during heavy usage, quicker app installations and faster game loading.

BUILT TOUGH AND STUNNING DISPLAY - Galaxy M47 5G is built to last long with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus+ Protection providing 4x Better Scratch Resistance, 2.0 m Fall Endurance, unleash your adventurous side without any worry. Its Water and Dust Resistant design adds everyday confidence. On the front, a segment leading FHD+ Super AMOLED Display with 120Hz Refresh Rate and High Brightness Mode delivers captivating visuals with instant touch response - whether you are gaming, streaming or scrolling even under a bright sunlight.

GAMING NON-STOP - Galaxy M47 5G is powered with bigger 6000 mAh battery and up to 8GB of RAM for you to enjoy extended gaming hours without any lag. It supports Bypass charging which gives more power to your phone allowing throttle free performance during intense gaming sessions. It carries high level of optimisations with the latest Android 16 and One UI 8.5 putting unused apps in sleep mode which prevents background drain so your adventure never stops.

EXCLUSIVE BRAND PROMISE - Galaxy M47 5G comes with Segment Best 6 Gen of OS updates, 6 years of Security Upgrades, EAL5+ certified Knox Vault Security for enhanced Software and Hardware Security, and Seamless and secure payments with Samsung Wallet's Tap and Pay feature. Experience innovative AI features like Google Gemini, Circle to Search for enhanced search results and real time AI conversations. Stay worry free with the largest service network for smartphones, now serviced at more than 3300 touchpoints

ENHANCED CAMERA CAPABILITIES - Galaxy M47 5G mobile packs 50 MP OIS Triple Camera Setup with Front HDR Camera for a sharper, more detailed output in any light. Its HDR camera delivers vivid output even against bright backgrounds or harsh sunlight. It supports video recording in 4k resolution. The Nightography feature ensures stunning low light photos and its AI editing tools i.e. Object eraser, Edit suggestions and My Filter turn every picture into a masterpiece.
